headline: Atari releases Pong
post_facts: The test machine jammed with quarters

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen seventy-two... a little company called Atari released Pong.

scenes.label: Pong arcade cabinet
scenes.caption: Atari, 1972
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] It began as a practice project for a new engineer, Allan Alcorn.

scenes.label: Atari Pong
scenes.caption: A signed Pong cabinet
scenes.title: Jammed with quarters
scenes.text: [softly] When the test machine in a California bar stopped working... its coin box was overflowing with quarters.

scenes.label: Pong machines sold by 1974
scenes.text: [calmly] By nineteen seventy-four, Atari had sold more than eight thousand machines.
